sentences.text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a mean BLEU of 28.4 ± 0.6 over 8 seeds, outperforming Varrow-NMT (27.6 ± 0.8) by 0.8 BLEU points.
This difference was statistically significant (paired t-test, t(7)=3.13, p=0.017, 95% CI [0.2, 1.44] for the mean paired difference in BLEU).
Tessaline also substantially outperformed the PhraseGrid baseline (22.1 ± 0.8 BLEU) by 6.3 BLEU points, a significant improvement (paired t-test, t(7)=31.57, p<0.001, 95% CI [5.87, 6.83]).
